## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior, including material limits.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results.

## Documentation

- [ ] Reviewed affected guides, Rustdoc, feature status, defaults, limits, and commands.
- [ ] Updated `docs/features.toml` and regenerated `docs/FEATURES.md` when capabilities or package metadata changed.
- [ ] Ran `python3 scripts/check-docs.py`.
- [ ] Tested Rustdoc examples and built the reference when API documentation changed.

If no documentation changes are needed, explain why. Record new platform/host
evidence in `docs/WORK_STATUS.md` and significant decisions in `docs/decisions/`.
